content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing difficulties connecting [product_name] [version_no] to [product_name] [version_no]. Whenever I attempt this, I encounter the following error message: "An unexpected error occurred: your data may be inconsistent and subsequent errors may occur. java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException:1" This popup appears even if I double-click in the bottom left of the [product_name] frame to select hardware, regardless of whether I'm connected to the [version_no] or not. System details: - MacOS version: 10.6.8 - Java version: 1.6.43-B01-447 (both 16-bit and 32-bit) Thank you very much.

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports receiving a critical Java ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException error when connecting [product_name] [version_no] to [product_name] modules ([version_no]) on MacOS 10.6.8 with Java 1.6.43. The error occurs during hardware selection, both online and offline, indicating a fundamental issue or bug affecting stability and reliability of the software.
